Build a lecture recap web app in `user-apps/lecture-recap` using the Smart
Classroom backend:

- A teacher uploads a class recording (`.wav`, `.mp3`, or `.m4a`).
- The page shows the transcript as it is produced, then the summary as it
  streams in, then the mind map.
- A button downloads the transcript and summary as one Markdown file.
